title: Keeping Customers: CRM Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 33
description:
For a whole year, Mrs. Rao bought a Laddoo Lab 6-pack every week. Then, in July, she quietly stopped, and nobody noticed for a month. In this animated lesson, Zoya learns how to remember every customer and keep them coming back.

You will see Kotler and Armstrong's definition of customer relationship management (CRM), why winning a new customer can cost five to ten times more than keeping one, and a live run of CRM for Mrs. Rao: Dev's customer book, a weekly Saturday message, the warning sign of two missed Sundays, and Zoya's call that wins her back with a new flavour. Then we look at the base of CRM and three ways to build loyalty (financial benefits, social benefits and structural ties) with workplace examples from a pharmacy, an airline, a bank and a food delivery app. We also look at the human side honestly: too many messages feel like spam, and in India the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 says firms need your clear consent to use your personal data.

This is Episode 33 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
